p: went up with Zerubbabel the son: From Babylon to Jerusalem.
chief of the priests and of: Next in dignity to the high priests and who were of the stock of Aaron.
which was over the thanksgiving: Had charge of them who sang the psalms.
watches: They kept the wards and watches according to their turns, 2Ch 23:6.
Seraiah: That is, next to Seraiah or rather of the order, who was called after the name of Seraiah.
Abijah: Of which was Zachariah, John the Baptist's father.
against ward: That is, one after another and every one in his course.
Netophathi: Who were a certain family and had their possessions in the fields, 1Ch 2:54.
I brought up the princes of: Meaning, Nehemiah.
his brethren: That is, the brass throne of Zaccur.
stairs of the city of David: Which was going up to the mount Zion, which is called the city of David.
over the chambers for the treasures: Which were chambers appointed by Hezekiah to put in the tither, and such things, 2Ch 31:11 and now were repaired again for the same use.
sanctified them unto the children of: That is, the tenth part of the tithes.
